label: IELTS
description: IELTS exam: IELTS Ready, British Council, test dates, test changes, registration, results, speaking/writing practice.

label: Security
description: Security alerts, new sign-in notices, device verification, one-time codes, password resets (Google, Microsoft, GitHub, etc.).

label: Study Tracker
description: Automated study or habit-tracker reminders and progress check-ins.

label: Service Updates
description: Product announcements, terms/policy changes, feature news from apps and services. Not security alerts.

label: Scholarship
description: Scholarship opportunities, funding, grants, bursaries, stipends or financial aid for study.

label: Masters App
description: Master's degree applications: admissions, application portals, offer letters, SOP/LOR, deadlines.

label: Projects
description: Personal or side-project discussions and collaborators. Not automated GitHub/Jira notifications.

label: IT
description: General IT/tech: cloud accounts, hosting, software licences, tech newsletters. Not security alerts or codes.

label: Dev/GitHub
description: GitHub notifications: pull requests, reviews, issues, CI/Actions runs, releases.

label: Dev/Jira
description: Jira/Atlassian notifications: tickets assigned, comments, status changes, sprints.

label: Dev/Slack
description: Slack notification emails: mentions, DMs, workspace digests.

label: Dev/Teams
description: Microsoft Teams notification emails: missed messages, mentions, meeting chats.

label: LinkedIn
description: LinkedIn emails: messages, recruiter InMail, job alerts, connection requests, notifications.

label: STARRED
description: Needs MY action or reply soon: a real person asking me something, a PR review requested from me, deadlines, exam or application changes. Not newsletters, codes or automated digests.

label: IMPORTANT
description: Official or high-stakes: exam bodies, universities, scholarships, banks, visa/immigration, account security problems, recruiters with a concrete job.
